newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary invites five banks for Takarekbank sale.
newsitem.headline: Hungary invites five banks for Takarekbank sale.

text.p: Hungary's state privatisation agency APV Rt said on Friday it has invited five foreign banks to bid for the state's 61 percent stake in Takarekbank Rt.

The five are Autria's GiroCredit and Oesterreichische Volksbank, Germany's Deutsche Genossenschaftsbank, France's Credit Agricole and Canada's Desjardins group, said Zsolt Szakaly, the APV official handling Takarekbank's sale.
The five have until April 1 to submit their bids, he said.
Takarekbank serves as the nationwide umbrella bank for Hungary's regional savings cooperatives, which own a 33 percent stake in the bank, Szakaly said.
APV requires the buyer of Takarekbank to offer an option without time limits to the cooperatives to increase their stake to 50 percent plus one share, he said.
The buyer also must guarantee that Takarekbank would continue to work together with the cooperatives in the meantime, he said.
Takarekbank made a profit of 224.5 million forints in 1995 and had assets of 5.2 billion at the end of that year. The bank's 1996 pre-tax profit target is 400 million forints.
